messages.author: 361380a5f4a45be0
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: simple question
parts:
Iara,
I can understand the hesitancy then.
I can't speak to Notepad++, since I haven't used it personally (some of my coworkers use it at work for SQL, so it's pretty general). As far as Windows editors go, once I learned about the R plugins for Vi, I never bothered which much else. 

I used Tinn-R for awhile though, so that may be worth a look. 3 years ago it was a detached editor with syntax highlighting and sourcing to an R console, so that may do you better than RStudio. http://www.sciviews.org/Tinn-R/
